description: Cases for spec/plugin-manifest.md. Each case in cases validates fragment against a schema named by against: core#/$defs/<name> is the core, and <schema> or <schema>#/$defs/<name> is one of schemas. A refusal gives the pointer of the key the refusal must name, relative to the fragment, the key as an author reads it, and a suggestion; alsoNames lists the other keys one refusal names. Each case in rules is a whole manifest that passes the core and tests one rule beyond the schema; files and symlinks are created first, relative to the plugin root. mutation pins what a host derives from effects, and renaming pins a mounted tool's command name. The schemas are test fixtures, not any host's profile.

profile.title: A reference profile: every core object closed at every depth, kinds closed, one effect refused wherever effects appear, a section added, ui defined, and a kind that needs its section, in allOf because a conditional beside $ref breaks Ajv

cousin.title: The mistake: plugin closed beside its own properties with no $ref of its own. The $ref at the root reaches plugin on a sibling path, so unevaluatedProperties cannot see what it evaluated

cousinSuite.title: The JSON Schema test suite's case, "unevaluatedProperties can't see inside cousins"

shallow.title: The root closed and nothing else: unevaluatedProperties does not reach into a nested object, which is why the contract closes every depth

overreach.title: A profile that breaks the limits: it defines a reserved key and widens a core vocabulary. The core still refuses both
